description: This file defines the MessageAnnotationsExtractAdapter class, which implements the io.opentracing.propagation.TextMap interface. It acts as an adapter for extracting message annotation properties from an AMQP 1.0 message's annotations, facilitating tracing propagation.

classes.name: MessageAnnotationsExtractAdapter
classes.description: An adapter implementing TextMap to extract properties from AMQP message annotations for tracing purposes.

methods.name: MessageAnnotationsExtractAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a message and a properties map name, ensuring none are null.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the message annotation properties as key-value pairs of strings.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Unsupported operation; this method throws an exception if called as modifying the message annotations isn't supported.

methods.name: getPropertiesMap
methods.description: Retrieves the properties map from message annotations, ensuring correct type and presence.
